cost_model.note: No net-performance claim until explicit costs exist.

validation_protocol.chronology: date-ordered train/validation/test; controls selected using information available as-of event time
validation_protocol.overlap_control: purge overlapping forward-label windows and embargo adjacent observations
matching_balance: standardized mean difference by control dimension
validation_protocol.uncertainty: block/bootstrap confidence intervals respecting temporal dependence; report point estimate plus interval, not probability when sample gate fails
validation_protocol.walk_forward: expanding and rolling windows; hyperparameters fixed inside each training window only

sample_gates.minimum_per_reported_regime: must be predeclared before estimation; otherwise regime result UNKNOWN

match balance fails or unmatched rate makes inference sparse
effect disappears under key control ablations
